text.description_html:
Bommer CL4030-6-651 - 6" Single Acting Spring Hinge with Classic Ball Tips

Packaged completed with one Single Action Spring Door Hinge plus #12 x 1-1/4" wood screws and 12-24 x 1/2" machine screws . Fits 4-1/2" template screw hole pattern for use on metal or wood doors.

UL Listed For Fire Rated Door Applications. 4-1/2" template hole pattern (Standard 4-1/2" Mortise ANSI K81071F).

Also available with out Ball Tips: Bommer 4030-6 6" Spring Hinge

Bommer spring hinges are certified Grade 1 (highest grade) for 1 million cycles and made in the USA. For wood or metal doors 1-3/4" thick.

Specifications for Bommer CL4030-6 6" Spring Hinge

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 5"
  • Corners: Square Corners
  • Gauge of Metal: .134
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" Thick Doors
  • 4-1/2" Template Hole Pattern
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Hinge Material: Durable Steel
  • Factory Set Spring Tension
  • Non-Handed
  • Classic Ball Tips
  • Polished Chrome Finish
  • BHMA Certified Grade 1 for 1 million cycles.
  • UL Listed For Fire Rated Door Applications ("A" label openings)
  • Full Mortise - ANSI K81071F
  • Available Finishes: 2
  • Bommer CL4030-6 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)
